hero.lead: I build multi-brand products in React, TypeScript and Next.js — one shared core of logic and UI, every brand shipped from it.

rota.label: A hollow gear in the centre, outlined like the DMYTRO name. Four straight lines run from it to four circles set on an oval ring around it, each holding a small cropped outline drawing: a monitor on a stand for Client at top left, a stack of three rack servers for Server at top right, a database cylinder for Database at bottom right, a neural network for AI at bottom left. The circles are joined by the ring, clockwise: HTTP between client and server, SQL between server and database, context and embeddings between database and AI, prompt and stream between AI and client.

intro.title: Projects
intro.lead: Seven tavole from six years of building for the web — commercial products in Ukraine, Ireland and Canada, a framework migration, and things I made for myself.
intro.body: Some are foundations other teams build on: a monorepo that ships five brands, a design system with every state drawn. Some are product work measured in speed — a lab product moved to Vue and made 27% faster, a client site made 31% faster. And some are mine: a goal tree that grows from one root, and a club app still on the drawing board.

soft2bet-platform.label: Frontend architecture
soft2bet-platform.title: Multi-brand iGaming platform
soft2bet-platform.summary: Five production brands shipped from one monorepo: shared logic, UI Kit and a brand template.
soft2bet-platform.task: Five production brands shipped from one monorepo: shared business logic, a UI Kit and a per-brand app template.
soft2bet-platform.role: Frontend Developer · team of 3 + tech lead
soft2bet-platform.contribution: Built features and reviewed code across every brand; worked in the shared logic, the UI Kit and the brand template; shipped to test and production through GitLab CI/CD.
soft2bet-platform.impact: Five production brands run on one codebase — logic and UI are written once.
soft2bet-platform.challenge: Keeping five brands visibly different while their logic and UI stay one codebase — so a change for one brand never breaks another.

life-focus-tree.label: Fullstack · Pet project
life-focus-tree.title: Life Focus Tree
life-focus-tree.summary: Goals grow as a radial perk tree from a single root — “Life” — with animated, evenly spread seeds.
life-focus-tree.task: Goals grow as a radial perk tree from a single root — “Life” — with animated, evenly spread seeds.
life-focus-tree.contribution: Everything end to end: the radial layout and its animation, a thin GraphQL API, the data model and accounts.
life-focus-tree.impact: Goals and focus areas read as one growing tree instead of a flat to-do list.
life-focus-tree.challenge: Laying out hundreds of nodes evenly around one root, and animating new seeds in while their neighbours move aside smoothly instead of jumping.

innopharma-migration.label: Fullstack · Migration
innopharma-migration.title: AngularJS → Vue migration
innopharma-migration.summary: Moved a lab product to Vue and TypeScript: +27% performance, 3× faster debugging and new features.
innopharma-migration.task: Moved a lab product from AngularJS to Vue and TypeScript, and kept shipping features on the way.
innopharma-migration.contribution: Migrated the product to Vue + TypeScript, shipped a new product feature end to end, implemented OAuth 2 permissions and ran two TypeScript trainings for the team.
innopharma-migration.impact: +27% performance, debugging and new features 3× faster.
innopharma-migration.challenge: Replacing the framework under a working lab product piece by piece, while new features kept shipping on top of it.

sports-platform.label: Fullstack
sports-platform.title: Sports platform client
sports-platform.summary: The web client of a sports platform, and the API layer that talks to it through an OAuth gateway.
sports-platform.task: The web client of a sports platform, and the API layer that talks to it through an OAuth gateway.
sports-platform.contribution: Built the Next.js + TypeScript client and designed the API layer behind the OAuth gateway, working directly with the designer and the backend team.
sports-platform.impact: The client and a secured API layer, delivered together with design and backend.
sports-platform.challenge: Keeping every request from the client behind the OAuth gateway, while staying close to the design and in step with the backend.

studio-sites.label: Product UI
studio-sites.title: Studio client sites
studio-sites.summary: Websites for design-studio clients, many of them running on a CMS.
studio-sites.task: Websites for design-studio clients, many of them running on a CMS.
studio-sites.contribution: Built React projects for studio clients, added features to CMS-based sites and optimised one of them.
studio-sites.impact: 10+ React projects delivered; one CMS-based site made 31% faster.
studio-sites.challenge: Making a slow CMS-based site fast without rebuilding it — the gain had to come from what was already there.

codex-portfolio.label: Design system
codex-portfolio.title: Codex — this portfolio
codex-portfolio.summary: A design system drawn like an engineer’s notebook — tokens, a UI Kit with every state — and the site built on it.
codex-portfolio.task: A design system drawn like an engineer’s notebook — tokens, a UI Kit with every state — and the site built on it.
codex-portfolio.contribution: The concept, the tokens and the UI Kit, then the Next.js site: FSD architecture, EN / FR content, a spam-protected contact form and tests.
codex-portfolio.impact: Every page is assembled from one token set and one UI Kit, every state drawn.
codex-portfolio.challenge: Turning a visual metaphor — an engineer’s notebook — into a strict system: every component, every state, one set of tokens.

sports-club-manager.label: Fullstack · Pet project
sports-club-manager.title: Sports club manager
sports-club-manager.summary: An app to run a sports club — members, sessions and the club itself. Still on the drawing board.
sports-club-manager.task: An app to run a sports club — members, sessions and the club itself. Still on the drawing board.
sports-club-manager.contribution: Designing the data model around three entities: members, sessions and the club.
sports-club-manager.challenge: Deciding how members, sessions and the club relate to each other before any code is written.
